major: 戏剧影视文学 Theatre, Film & TV Literature
bio_cn: 大家好，我是南京大学戏剧影视文学专业的张博皓，热爱电影、阅读与文字创作，希望能与大家度过一段愉快的创想时光！
bio_en: Hello everyone! I’m Zhang Bohao, majoring in Theater and Film Literature at Nanjing University. With a passion for cinema, reading, and literary creation, I look forward to sharing an enjoyable creative journey with you all.

university: 中国科学技术大学 University of Science and Technology of China
bio_cn: 来自广东省，现于中科大就读，对音乐和阅读感兴趣。
bio_en: From Guangdong Province, currently studying at the University of Science and Technology of China with a passion for music and reading.

major: 广播电视编导 Radio & TV Directing
bio_cn: 大家好，我是同济大学艺术与传媒学院2023级广播电视编导专业的陈月涵。擅长视频拍摄与脚本创作，热爱影像叙事。希望在本次夏令营交流学习，恳请老师们多多指教。
bio_en: Hello everyone, I’m Chen Yuehan, a 2023 student majoring in Radio and Television Directing at the School of Art and Media, Tongji University. With expertise in video production and scriptwriting, I have a passion for visual storytelling. I look forward to learning and exchanging ideas during this summer camp and sincerely appreciate your guidance.

university: 南京师范大学 Nanjing Normal University
major: 播音与主持艺术 Broadcasting & Hosting Arts
bio_cn: 大家好，我叫周墨，来自南京师范大学播音与主持艺术专业，对ai/agent非常感兴趣，自己也有较为成熟的个人项目，打过几次黑客松，期待与你相遇！
bio_en: Hello everyone, my name is Zhou Mo. I major in Broadcasting and Hosting Arts at Nanjing Normal University, with a strong interest in AI/agents and several well-developed personal projects under my belt. I’ve participated in multiple hackathons and look forward to meeting you!

major: 艺术理论与评论 Art Theory & Criticism
bio_cn: 成凯，南开大学文学院艺术理论与评论方向研二在读，关注现代视觉文化、媒介理论与艺术批评，具备较强文本阅读与写作能力。
bio_en: Cheng Kai is a second-year graduate student in Art Theory and Criticism at the School of Liberal Arts, Nankai University, specializing in modern visual culture, media theory, and art criticism, with strong skills in textual analysis and writing.

major: 数字媒体技术 Digital Media Technology
bio_cn: 我是上海大学上海电影学院数字媒体技术专业的大三学生，我叫沈怡均。我喜欢阅读，打游戏，玩滑板，做ai短片。很高兴参加这次活动。
bio_en: I’m Shen Yijun, a third-year student majoring in Digital Media Technology at the Shanghai Film Academy of Shanghai University. My hobbies include reading, gaming, skateboarding, and creating AI-generated short films. I’m thrilled to participate in this event.

university: 南京特殊教育师范学院 Nanjing Normal University of Special Education
bio_cn: 大家好，我叫刘金舜，来自南京特殊教育师范学院。作为特殊教育专业学生，我热爱书法，羽毛球与艺术，也对人工智能充满好奇，期待探索科技如何赋能艺术与教育。
bio_en: Hello everyone, my name is Liu Jinshun, and I am a student at Nanjing Normal University of Special Education. As a specialist in special education, I have a passion for calligraphy, badminton, and the arts, while also being deeply curious about artificial intelligence. I look forward to exploring how technology can empower art and education.

university: 北京航空航天大学 Beihang University
major: 信息艺术设计 Information Art & Design
bio_cn: 大家好，我叫张书瑶，来自北京航空航天大学，是信息艺术设计专业的大三学生。我平时热爱摄影与电影，乐于探索各类新鲜领域，很荣幸能与各位在此相遇，期待接下来一同探索新知、并肩成长。
bio_en: Hello everyone, my name is Zhang Shuyao. I am a third-year student majoring in Information Art Design at Beihang University. I have a passion for photography and film, and enjoy exploring various innovative fields. It’s a great honor to meet you all here, and I look forward to exploring new knowledge and growing together with you.

major: 战略营销与商业分析 Strategic Marketing & Business Analytics
bio_cn: 就读于莫纳什大学，主修营销与BA。曾获欧莱雅BrandStorm等创新大奖。期待跨界交流，探索AI与人文艺术的交叉领域。
bio_en: Study in Monash University on a Bachelor of Arts in Marketing. Has received multiple innovation awards, including the L’Oréal BrandStorm Award. Enthusiastic about interdisciplinary collaboration and exploring the intersection of AI with humanities and arts.

university: 浙江师范大学 Zhejiang Normal University
bio_cn: 本人学习认真，责任心强，具备良好沟通协作能力，能积极面对挑战，在实践中不断提升专业素养与综合能力。
bio_en: I am a diligent learner with a strong sense of responsibility, excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to proactively tackle challenges while continuously enhancing my professional expertise and overall capabilities through practical experience.

university: 西安石油大学 Xi’an Shiyou University
bio_cn: 就读西安石油大学环境设计专业，长期关注数字化空间设计。有幸参与本届人工智能、艺术与创意方法国际暑期学校，期待以AI拓宽环境设计表达边界，碰撞跨界创意。
bio_en: A student majoring in Environmental Design at Xi’an Shiyou University, I have long been dedicated to digital spatial design. I am honored to participate in this year’s International Summer School on Artificial Intelligence, Art, and Creative Methods, where I aim to expand the expressive boundaries of environmental design through AI and foster interdisciplinary creativity.

bio_cn: 大家好，我是来自浙大传媒学院的金芊芊，曾获国家奖学金，在AI+艺术领域参与过“宋韵共创及对外传播”课题项目和创赛项目“文烁-文化出海大模型”，很高兴能和各位一起在南大继续对这个话题的探讨～
bio_en: Hello everyone, I’m Jin Qianqian from the School of Media and Communication at Zhejiang University. I’ve received the National Scholarship and have participated in the research project "Song Dynasty Charm Co-creation and International Dissemination" as well as the innovation competition project "Wenshuo – A Large-scale Cultural Export Model" in the AI + Art field. It’s a pleasure to continue exploring this topic with you all at Nanjing University.

university: 四川农业大学 Sichuan Agricultural University
major: 视觉传达设计 Visual Communication Design
bio_cn: 我是一个不能吃辣的四川人，我是一个会在观鸟、观虫上花时间的人，我是一个喜欢偷学别人专业课程然后多次被老师发现之前没见过我的人。
bio_en: I’m a Sichuan native who can’t handle spicy food. I’m someone who spends their time watching birds and bugs. And I’m someone who likes to sneak into classes from other majors, only to be repeatedly caught out by professors who realize they’ve never seen my face before.

university: 山东师范大学 Shandong Normal University
bio_cn: 大家好，我是李佳怡，来自山东师范大学，山师春天的花很美，这张照片就拍摄于今年的春天。我的mbti是intj，乐于接受新事物，新挑战，新观念，新态度。我把这次的活动视为自我丰盈的良机，期待和你们的见面。Hello everyone, I’m Li Jiayi from Shandong Normal University. The spring flowers here are truly beautiful – this photo was taken this spring. My MBTI type is IntJ, and I embrace new things, challenges, ideas, and perspectives with enthusiasm. I see this event as a great opportunity for personal growth, and I look forward to meeting you all.

university: 南京师范大学 Nanjing Normal University
bio_cn: 大家好，我是童元媛，刚毕业于南师大英语翻译专业，已获澳国立数字人文硕士录取。我十分期待在此潜心学习，和各位伙伴交流协作。
bio_en: Hello everyone, I’m Tong Yuanyuan, having just graduated from the English Translation program at Nanjing Normal University and now admitted to the Master’s program in Digital Humanities at the Australian National University. I’m truly excited to immerse myself in my studies here and collaborate with all of you.

bio_cn: 大家好，我叫吉书乐，在南安普顿大学读哲学专业大一。是一个因热爱跳舞所以被迫由i变e，但又喜欢旅行所以希望下辈子投胎成一只流浪的兔子的infj。很高兴认识大家，未来的十几天也请大家多多关照！
bio_en: Hello everyone, my name is Jishule. I’m a first-year philosophy student at the University of Southampton—a true INFJ who ended up changing my character from ‘I’ to ‘E’ out of passion for dancing, yet still dreams of being reborn as a stray rabbit due to my love for travel. It’s great to meet you all, and I’d appreciate your continued support over the next few weeks!

bio_cn: 各位老师同学大家好，我叫张梦娜，江苏人，我来自常州大学艺术学院美术学专业中国画方向，目前在申请艺术史相关的phd，研究课题以明清以及近代艺术史为主，很期待这次的暑期科研学习，希望Ai能给艺术创作和艺术史研究带来全新的视角和体验。
bio_en: Hello, esteemed teachers and fellow students. My name is Zhang Mengna, from Jiangsu Province, and I am a student majoring in Chinese Painting at the School of Fine Arts, Changzhou University. I am currently pursuing a PhD in Art History with a focus on the art history of the Ming, Qing, and modern periods. I am eagerly anticipating this summer research program, hoping it will offer fresh perspectives and valuable experiences for both artistic creation and art historical studies.

bio_cn: 大家好，我叫郑池，是南京大学艺术学院的硕士研究生。我的研究方向偏向艺术史与视觉文化相关领域，一直很关注数字技术、人工智能介入艺术研究与艺术创作的前沿议题。希望借着这次暑期学校的机会，系统学习跨媒介、数字人文相关的知识，拓宽自己的学术思路。
bio_en: Hello everyone, my name is Zheng Chi. I am a postgraduate student majoring in art studies at the School of Art, Nanjing University. My research focuses on art history and visual culture, and I have long been fascinated by cutting-edge topics concerning how digital technologies and AI intervene in artistic research and creation. I hope to take advantage of this summer school to systematically learn knowledge about cross-media studies and digital humanities and broaden my academic horizons.

bio_cn: 大家好，我叫石泞溪，是南京大学艺术学院的硕士生。我的学术兴趣主要集中于跨媒介叙事领域，尤其是数字时代新的叙事形态。我希望通过这次暑期学校探索数字技术如何重塑文化生产与学术研究。我平时喜欢看书、电影和二次创作。期待向大家学习，希望和大家成为朋友!
bio_en: Hello everyone, my name is Shi Ningxi, and I am a master’s student at the School of Art, Nanjing University. My academic interests primarily focus on cross-media narrative, particularly new narrative forms in the digital age. Through this summer school, I hope to explore how digital technology is reshaping cultural production and academic research. In my free time, I enjoy reading, watching films, and creating derivative works. I look forward to learning from all of you and forming friendships with each of you!

bio_cn: 大家好，我叫王大中，是南京大学艺术学院24级硕士研究生。我的兴趣比较广泛，对学术探索和生活体验都抱有同样的热情。无论是严肃的科研话题，还是轻松的日常趣事，都很乐意和各位多多交流，期待一起在这次暑校中共同进步！
bio_en: Hello everyone, my name is Wang Dazhong. I am a master’s student at the School of Arts, Nanjing University, admitted in 2024. I have a wide range of interests and am equally passionate about academic exploration and everyday life experiences. Whether it’s serious research topics or lighthearted daily anecdotes, I’m always happy to chat with all of you. I truly look forward to learning and growing together with everyone at this summer school.

major: Film, TV and Digital Media Year 1
bio_cn: 嗨，我是 James Wickham。我是一名铁人三项运动员、乒乓球教练，也热爱登山徒步。目前我在学习电影专业，一直对深入了解人工智能充满好奇与兴趣！非常期待探索中国文化，走进这所中国最顶尖的学府之一！
bio_en: Hi there my name is James Wickham.I am a triathlete, table tennis coach and passionate mountain hiker. I am currently studying film which is fascinating and I have always wanted to deepen my knowledge of AI since I find it intriguing! I can’t wait to explore Chinese culture and one of its most prestigious universities!

major: BA Philosophy, Politics and Economics Year 1
bio_cn: 我是 Alex，南安普顿大学哲学、政治与经济学一年级学生。从学生时代起我就不断尝试创业和各种项目，驱使我的是一种凡事追问"为什么"的好奇心。正是这种好奇心让我着迷于 AI 如何重塑我们所创造和珍视的一切。非常期待这个夏天和大家一起探索这些问题！
bio_en: I’m Alex, a first-year PPE student at Southampton. I’ve been building businesses and various ventures since school, driven by asking why things work the way they do. That curiosity now has me fascinated by how AI is reshaping what we create and value. I can’t wait to explore these questions this summer!

bio_cn: 嗨，我叫 Vlada，来自俄罗斯。目前在南安普顿大学攻读历史与古代史。学习之余，我喜欢旅行、阅读、参观博物馆和美术馆、骑马、打高尔夫和健身。我对现代艺术与商业的交汇特别感兴趣，热爱探索新地方、体验不同文化、结识来自不同背景的人。
bio_en: Hi, my name is Vlada, I’m from Russia. I’m currently studying History and Ancient History at the University of Southampton. Outside of my studies, I enjoy travelling, reading, visiting museums and galleries, horse riding, playing golf, and spending time at the gym. I’m particularly interested in the intersection of modern art and business, and I love exploring new places, experiencing different cultures, and meeting people from diverse backgrounds.

bio_cn: 大家好！我叫 Lisa，在温彻斯特艺术学院学习游戏设计与艺术。正如我的学位所体现的那样，我对电子游戏和任何形式的艺术都充满热情。非常期待了解新技术如何与创意交融。
bio_en: Hello! My name is Lisa and I study Games Design and Art at WSA.As my degree probably suggests, I’m very passionate about video games and art of any kind, so I’m excited to learn more about how newer technologies can be intertwined with creativity.

bio_cn: 嗨，我是 Lavanya Sharma，南安普顿大学平面传达专业学生，对 UX 设计、新兴技术和文化创新充满热情。我喜爱创建以用户为中心的数字体验，探索 AI 和沉浸式设计，并参与结合创意、研究与有意义的现实影响力的国际合作项目。
bio_en: Hi, I’m Lavanya Sharma, a Graphic Communication student at the University of Southampton with a passion for UX design, emerging technologies, and cultural innovation. I enjoy creating user-centred digital experiences, exploring AI and immersive design, and collaborating on international projects that combine creativity, research, and meaningful real-world impact.

bio_cn: 嗨，我是 Russell，在南安普顿大学学习英语与历史。我对艺术与文化史特别感兴趣，也关注技术进步及其如何改变历史记录的方式。非常期待这次暑期学校！
bio_en: Hi, I’m Russell and I study English/History at Southampton, I have a particular interest in the history of art and culture, as well as technological advancements and how they can change historical documentation, so I’m really excited for this summer school!

major: Film with a minor in Philosophy Year 4
bio_cn: 嗨嗨！我是 Killian，一半土耳其血统一半爱尔兰血统，学习电影与哲学。请向我推荐任何你喜欢的电影！超级期待在南京的学习时光，希望我们能成为好朋友！
bio_en: Hiya Hiya. I’m Killian. I am half Turkish and half Irish and I study Film & Philosophy, so please recommend me any films that you like!  I am super excited to study at Nanjing. I hope we can become great friends!

bio_cn: 我是Wang Tianjin，南安普顿大学音乐教育专业硕士研究生。我的研究兴趣在于音乐、策展和公众参与，特别是创意与技术方法如何增强叙事影响力，加深观众对艺术、文化和遗产的理解。
bio_en: My name is Wang Tianjin, and I am a master’s student in Music Education at the University of Southampton. My research interests lie in music, curation, and public engagement, particularly in how creative and technological approaches can enhance narrative impact and deepen audiences’ understanding of art, culture, and heritage.

major: Philosophy, Politics, and Economics BA Year 3
bio_cn: 嗨！我是南安普顿大学哲学、政治与经济学专业三年级学生。我对政治、切尔西足球俱乐部、国际象棋和语言学习等充满热情。我为中国着迷，无论是古代还是现代，因此非常兴奋能参与这次项目。
bio_en: Hi! I am a 3rd Year PPE student at the University of Southampton. I am deeply interested in politics, Chelsea FC, chess, learning languages, as well as a few other things. I am fascinated by China, both ancient and modern, so I am extremely excited to participate in this programme.

bio_cn: 我叫Yujie Wang，南安普顿大学视觉传达专业三年级学生。我的兴趣领域包括交互设计、数字媒体艺术和平面设计，作品聚焦于以人为本和包容性设计。我期待探索 AI 如何应用于为人而设计，拓展当代设计实践的边界。
bio_en: My name is Yujie Wang. I am a third-year Visual Communication student at the University of Southampton, interested in interaction design, digital media art, and graphic design. My work focuses on human-centered and inclusive design. I am excited to explore how AI can be applied to design for people and expand the boundaries of contemporary design practice.

bio_cn: 我是 Indraja，奢侈品牌管理硕士生。我热爱艺术，生活离不开音乐播放列表。我最快乐的时刻是在一个新地方——我收集体验，就像别人收集物品一样。新地点、新面孔和新视角让我保持好奇，而这种好奇心如今塑造了我对品牌的思考方式。
bio_en: I’m Indraja, an MA Luxury Brand Management student. I love art and live by my playlist, and I’m happiest when I’m somewhere new — I collect experiences the way others collect things. New places, new people, and new perspectives keep me curious, and that curiosity now shapes how I think about brands.
